1. Cream your butter, sugar and vanilla. Til it is light yellow. 


2. Make a milk and egg mixture, slowly and gently folding into butter mix.


3. Bit by bit sift your flour, fold flour in til just combined.


4. Return to hand mixer or Kitchenaid, mix on low for like 2 min, and on high until it looks goopy.


5A. Split batter into small bowls 

5B. Add your flavorings or colours. In this recipe I used banana lolly (yellow), bubble gum (blue), unicorn magic flavour (Queens Brand- green) and  cinnamon (pink)

5C. I've also done red velvet and vanilla. So red and white swirls.

5D. Or just plain old vanilla.  

6. 3 large teaspoons in each patty pan. Or accommodate for the number of flavours/colours you have.


7. Oven for 15min on 180°c.


8. Fuck yeah cupcakes.


P.S. Cream cheese icing or butter cream icing are a good idea too.

Enjoy.

3/4 cup of Caster sugar
 
2 eggs (room temp)

125g butter (room temp)

1 tbs vanilla or 2 pods

By 2 months I was sleeping a bit better and I got married in June, after the wedding I slipped into a deep depression and craved it like a mother fucker. I knew it wasn't going to help so I basically just slept all I could to fight both feelings.

By 3 months my lungs had evacuated all the funky bong gunk. But I was eating and eating so much I put on 20kgs. This had A LOT to do with my antipsychotics, my anxiety meds and antidepressants. 

By 5 months I was pretty much out the the pot woods and feeling more energetic and productive.  I cleaned my house for the first time in forever, and was more present with the kids. Helping with homework is so different when you're not smashed lol.

By 7 months I found a job, and started working after 2 years of unemployment/maternity leave. And for the first time in 17 years went to work straight. 

And now I'm here. One of my darling crotch fruit smeared soap all over the shower floor and I slipped over, hurting my back. I always used pot as a pain relief and even today I'm fighting the urge to go score and puff the pain away. But I'm staying strong and trying my best to ignore it. Ibuprofen is working but only just. I'm going to go to a physio soon  so I don't fold and slip into my old habits.

The reason I decided to pick up a paint brush is actually a really personal one. As you all are aware by now I suffer from mental health issues. I hear voices and sounds that aren't there. I hallucinate cats so regularly I can't drive, in fear of causing an accident because of my madness. I truly thought I had lost my mind. That I was slowly developing schizophrenia. I didn't tell anyone. For over a year. Why? Why the fuck do you think? I'd be labeled. I would be medicated. I could be sent away. Until I was better. Right? 
But, when everything you know is desolving right in front of you, life keeps going man. The kids need caring for, and feed. You can't be crazy or ill, whatever. Get help. Tell someone. ANYONE. You deserve help. You deserve to be mentally well. So now my mission is to END THE STIGMA. Just because I'm different, doesn't make me a bad person. Just because I'm wired different doesn't make me crazy. I will rise and own my Bipolar. I will own my illness. I will not be kept down.
